name: Brite Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Brite Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., an integrated circuit design service company, provides customized ASIC and IP solutions in China and internationally. The company offers chip design and mass production services, as well as chip customization services, including chip definition and delivery, IP selection and authorization, specification and architecture design, logic and physical design, design data verification, tape-out solution design, and other full-process chip design services.
